facts.fact: The Ministry of Education unveiled a 15-member multi-agency team to build KEMIS, consolidating the separate registers for ECDE, basic education, TIVET and universities into one database, with a pilot announced for July 2025 and full transition in September, and with planned integration with the births and deaths register through Civil Registration Services and the National Registration Bureau.
